How much water does a lawn actually use compared with the alternatives? This estimates a season's irrigation for the same area planted different ways, from your climate and water price.

```{=html}
<div class="hmc" id="lw"></div>
<script>
(function () {
  // season reference evapotranspiration and usable rain, inches
  const CLIM = { desert: [55, 3], semi: [35, 7], temperate: [27, 14], humid: [26, 22] };
  // [name, plant factor (share of reference ET), irrigation efficiency]
  const OPT = [
    ['Kentucky bluegrass lawn', 0.8, 0.75], ['Tall fescue lawn', 0.7, 0.75], ['Buffalograss or blue grama lawn', 0.4, 0.75],
    ['Low-water shrubs and perennials (drip)', 0.3, 0.9], ['Native planting, once established', 0.15, 0.9], ['Mulch, gravel or hardscape', 0, 1]
  ];
  HM.tool({
    id: 'lw', step: 'Your yard',
    inputs: [
      { k: 'area', l: 'Area', t: 'area' },
      { k: 'clim', l: 'Climate', t: 'select', d: 'semi', opts: [['desert', 'Hot desert'], ['semi', 'Semi-arid (dry summers, cold winters)'], ['temperate', 'Temperate'], ['humid', 'Humid'], ['custom', 'My own numbers']] },
      { k: 'eto', l: 'Growing-season reference evapotranspiration', t: 'wdep', d: (u, v) => { const c = CLIM[(v && v.clim) || 'semi'] || CLIM.semi; return u === 'us' ? c[0] : Math.round(c[0] * 25.4 / 5) * 5; }, w: 3, h: 'Local weather networks publish this (ETo). The climate presets are rough.' },
      { k: 'rain', l: 'Usable rain in the season', t: 'wdep', d: (u, v) => { const c = CLIM[(v && v.clim) || 'semi'] || CLIM.semi; return u === 'us' ? c[1] : Math.round(c[1] * 25.4 / 5) * 5; }, w: 3 },
      { k: 'price', l: 'Water price', t: 'pwater', w: 3, h: 'From your water bill. Many utilities charge more at higher use.' }
    ],
    onChange(k, api) {
      if (k === 'clim' && CLIM[api.get('clim')]) { const c = CLIM[api.get('clim')], us = api.units() === 'us'; api.setDisp('eto', us ? c[0] : Math.round(c[0] * 25.4 / 5) * 5); api.setDisp('rain', us ? c[1] : Math.round(c[1] * 25.4 / 5) * 5); }
      if (k === 'eto' || k === 'rain') api.setChoice('clim', 'custom');
    },
    compute(v, U) {
      if (!(v.area > 0) || !(v.eto > 0)) return U.empty('Enter the area and your climate.');
      const rain = v.rain || 0;
      const rows = OPT.map(o => {
        const depth = Math.max(0, o[1] * v.eto - rain) / o[2]; // mm
        const L = depth * v.area; // litres
        return { o, depth, L, cost: v.price > 0 ? L / 1000 * v.price : null };
      });
      const base = rows[0].L;
      const g = x => U.us ? `${HM.fmt(x / 3.785411784, 0)} gal` : `${HM.fmt(x / 1000, 1)} m³`;
      let h = `<div class="step">Irrigation per season for ${U.f(v.area, 'area', 0)}</div><table class="tt"><thead><tr><th>Planting</th><th class="r">Water</th>${v.price > 0 ? '<th class="r">Cost</th>' : ''}</tr></thead><tbody>` +
        rows.map(r => `<tr><td>${r.o[0]}${r.L < base && base > 0 ? `<br><span class="tag good">${HM.fmt((1 - r.L / base) * 100, 0)}% less</span>` : ''}</td><td class="r">${g(r.L)}<br><span style="color:var(--ink-3)">${U.f(r.depth, 'wdep', 1)}</span></td>${v.price > 0 ? `<td class="r">${U.money(r.cost)}</td>` : ''}</tr>`).join('') + '</tbody></table>';
      if (rows[0].L === 0) h += U.note('Rain covers all the plants\' needs in this climate, so none of them needs irrigation in an average season.', 'good');
      h += U.note('Estimates for an average season with efficient watering. Real use is often higher: overwatering, leaks and poor coverage are common. The <a href="catch-cup-test.qmd">catch-cup test</a> shows how efficient your system is.');
      h += U.note('Low-water plantings use most of their water in the first one or two years while they establish.', 'good');
      return { html: h, work: [`Water need = plant factor × reference ET; irrigation = (need − usable rain) ÷ watering efficiency`].concat(rows.map(r => `${r.o[0]}: (${r.o[1]} × ${U.f(v.eto, 'wdep', 1)} − ${U.f(rain, 'wdep', 1)}) ÷ ${r.o[2]} = ${U.f(r.depth, 'wdep', 1)} → × ${U.f(v.area, 'area', 0)} = ${g(r.L)}`)) };
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```

## How this is worked out

Plants lose water through their leaves at a rate set mainly by weather: sun, heat, wind and dry air. Weather networks express that as **reference evapotranspiration (ETo)**: what a well-watered grass would use. Each planting uses a share of it: bluegrass close to 80%, buffalograss under half, established low-water shrubs a third or less. Subtract the rain the plants can use, allow for watering that's never perfectly efficient, and you have the irrigation.

The factors used here are typical values for planning. They're useful for comparing options, not for setting a controller: for that, use the [catch-cup test](catch-cup-test.qmd).
